The '''Cross of Glory Walk''' was a path in the [[Leisure Garden]] part of [[Axial Park]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], along which a number of [[Hologram/Legends|holostatues]] were situated to celebrate the heroes of the [[Jedi Civil War]] who had won the [[Cross of Glory]]: [[Revan/Legends|Revan]], [[Juhani]], [[Canderous Ordo]], [[Carth Onasi]], [[Mission Vao]], [[Zaalbar]], [[Jolee Bindo]] and [[Bastila Shan]].<ref name="The Old Republic" />
